general_sentiment.text:
Memecoins often follow the same predictable cycle: launch, attention, hype, repeat. But what if a token’s inspiration came from real-world events?

That is what makes @onlystreetsfun an interesting project to watch.

Coming soon to Solana, OnlyStreets is developing a launchpad built around turning real-life moments into tradable assets.

What particularly stands out to me is its approach to authenticity. Every coin must originate from a fresh photo captured directly through the app. Uploading an existing image from your gallery is not permitted.

That simple requirement introduces an interesting layer of accountability. Instead of relying entirely on recycled memes, edited images, or manufactured narratives, each launch has a direct connection to a moment captured in real time.

It also creates an interesting bridge between digital culture and everyday experiences. A random street encounter, an unusual sight, or a moment worth sharing could become the inspiration for an entirely new token.

Of course, the idea alone doesn’t guarantee successful launches, but it offers a different direction for a space that constantly needs fresh ideas.

Perhaps the next interesting memecoin won’t come from another recycled meme. It might come from something someone randomly captures while walking down the street.

I’m curious to see how they bring this concept to life.

Keep an eye on @onlystreetsfun and @rarelistio.
